##_resmarker_tables: The wide per-sample Terra table (one resmarker_<gene>_<codon> column per marker) exported to TSV, OR the pipeline's long resmarker_table.txt files. Do not mix the two shapes.
##_site_metadata: Omit for the wide per-sample table - it already carries Country/Region/District/Latitude/Longitude.
##_sample_ids: Restrict to a sample set: set to this.samples.<id column> when launching against a *_sample_set row.
##_selection_label: this.sample_set_id, so the report names the selection it covers.
